name: pizzadrop
description: Peer-to-peer, browser-to-browser file transfer with short links, QR codes and an animated ASCII pizza.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
